title: Inventory health-facility electricity reliability data sources
outcome: A dated source inventory classifies health-facility electricity sources by facility and service-area grain, reliability definition, backup and load fields, geography, access, and measurement limits.
inputs: WHO electricity in health-care facilities fact sheet
WHO Global Health Observatory HCF_REL_ELECTRICITY metadata
WHO Harmonized Health Facility Assessment and SARA instruments
Primary facility studies from Malawi, Ghana, and Uganda
expected_artifact: datasets.md update plus evidence.json records for each accepted source family.
validation_method: Domain reviewer checks each source URL, source date, sampling frame or instrument scope, facility and service-area grain, reliability definition, measurement mode, access conditions, and explicit limitations; a second reviewer reconstructs each classification from evidence.md.
done_condition: At least seven candidate source families are classified as usable, limited, or rejected with explicit reasons covering facility grain, service-area or device coverage, outage window, primary and backup source, load or function, geography, missingness, access, and whether the source observes service or only capacity.

title: Audit definitions of reliable and functional facility electricity
outcome: A reproducible crosswalk separates electricity presence, current function, reliability, backup, load capacity, service-area reach, maintenance, device function, and patient outcome.
expected_artifact: validation.md definition crosswalk and exclusion rules.
validation_method: Replicator applies the crosswalk to a sample of source fields and confirms that each field has one declared interpretation, denominator, measurement mode, and observation window.
done_condition: No field labelled connected, available, functional, reliable, backup, or ready remains unclassified or without a stated denominator, observation window, and non-use boundary.

title: Build one country or network facility-reliability baseline
outcome: A documented baseline shows where a named health-facility electricity pathway loses observable reliability without issuing a procurement or clinical recommendation.
inputs: public or reviewer-provided facility assessment records
facility master list and sampling frame
service-area, outage, backup, device, and maintenance fields
expected_artifact: outputs.md baseline specification plus a rerunnable analysis artifact and input hash.
validation_method: Replicator reruns the baseline from the documented input hash and environment, verifies every numerator and denominator, and checks that all conclusions remain within the observed setting.
done_condition: The baseline reports presence, current function, outage reliability, backup function, service-area or load coverage, missingness, and facility selection for one named setting, and a reviewer can identify the exact observation that would overturn the proposed bottleneck.

title: Red-team electricity reliability findings before allocation use
outcome: A failure-mode review blocks unsupported facility rankings, technology prescriptions, clinical interpretations, and blame from electricity-reliability findings.
expected_artifact: outputs.md red-team section with blocked uses and required review gates.
validation_method: Red-team reviewer tests each proposed use against self-report bias, missingness, seasonal outage, load mismatch, maintenance incentives, privacy, and facility blame; a second reviewer independently repeats the failure-mode check.
done_condition: Every candidate financing, procurement, clinical, or facility-ranking interpretation is either supported by a named denominator and replicated review status or explicitly blocked with a documented failure mode.

title: Check reliability outputs against a real infrastructure decision
outcome: A field-facing review names the responsible infrastructure user, decision timing, minimum evidence, maintenance pathway, data burden, and non-use cases.
inputs: local health and energy planning workflow
expected_artifact: playbooks.md field-reality section update and a structured review record.
validation_method: Field-reality reviewer records one responsible use and one explicit non-use; a red-team reviewer independently replicates the governance check and confirms that the artifact cannot bypass technical, clinical, privacy, or equity safeguards.
done_condition: A named decision-maker can identify one responsible use, one non-use, the minimum evidence needed before acting, who owns repair or monitoring, and how facilities or populations missing from the data are protected from adverse decisions; the governance check is independently replicated.
